title: Battle of Talikota (Rakshasi-Tengadi)
summary: On 23 January 1565 the allied armies of the Deccan sultanates defeated Vijayanagar at Talikota, also called Rakshasi-Tengadi. Rama Raya was captured on the field and beheaded, and the city of Vijayanagar was plundered and destroyed. Encyclopedia.com says the defeat ended the 200-year-old empire and opened the way for the later Mughal conquest of the Deccan.
